design_intent: 恢复早期未授权第三方角色式正文插图的极简黑线、大量纯白留白、低科技怪物件和克制强调色语法，但角色只使用用户自有的已授权角色 IP，不生成第三方未授权第三方角色或复刻上游案例。

surface.background: pure white #FFFFFF with at least 45 percent uninterrupted negative space
surface.line: economical hand-drawn black ink contour with slight natural wobble, open contours and sparse cross marks; clear, deliberate and readable rather than messy sketching
surface.objects: familiar low-tech physical props turned into one slightly absurd but causally accurate mechanism; no software panels, no industrial factory and no generic gears
surface.depth: almost flat; no gradients, paper texture, volumetric lighting or rendered shadows; only tiny grounding strokes when needed
surface.accent: one orange action path plus at most one tiny red or blue state cue; total colored area under 8 percent
surface.typography: does not choose a text strategy; direct-integrated may use a few short Chinese labels, while two-step-publish keeps the raw image text-free

forbidden: Ian Xiaohei character or any third-party protected character
copying an upstream example composition, prop combination, pose or label placement
felt, collage, printmaking or glossy 3D surface
text wall, pseudo-text, logo or watermark
